responsibility: Implements the RTL forward-propagation pass on top of RTL SSA, propagating single-definition values into uses to simplify expressions, improve addressing modes, remove unnecessary paradoxical subregs, and sometimes expose dead definitions. It builds SSA and dominance/loop context, decides when propagation across loops or into MEM addresses is profitable, rewrites uses via simplification routines, performs pending SSA updates and CFG cleanup, and provides the two pass variants "fwprop1" and the address-focused "fwprop2".
